result:
Summary: The Transformer model achieved a BLEU score of 28.4 on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task. The base models were trained for 12 hours, while the big models, which achieved better results, were trained for 3.5 days. The big Transformer model set a new BLEU score of 28.4 for English-to-German, outperforming all prior models. The sources do not provide specific details on the parameter differences between the base and big models.
